listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum , Dolce&Gabbana Beauty offers a fragrance for men that is as unique as it is sensual . Intense, attractive and sensual at the same time, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum tells the story of an authentic and modern man. Right from the start, the perfume creates a sparkling opening with the fusion of fresh citrus fruits, tangy blood orange and fine essences of lemon torchio. Finally, a sensual hint of wood, patchouli and vetiver is sprinkled through a warm Nagarmotha wood. K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a woody and spicy fragrance that offers an intimate glimpse into the heart of a modern king.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana Beauty adds another flower to the Dolce bouquet: DOLCE ROSE. The lively and beguiling eau de toilette shows the world another facet of the Dolce girls. Bold, optimistic and sociable, they say what they think and light up the streets with their feminine spontaneity. Dolce Rose captures this carefree joy in a fragrance that is as powerful and spirited as any Dolce Girl. The first eau de toilette in the Dolce collection, Dolce Rose celebrates the queen of flowers, a symbol of love, beauty and femininity and a signature motif in Dolce&Gabbana's work. Created by master perfumer Violaine Collas, the fragrance combines delicate rose absolute and fresh centifolia notes with soft musk and tangy redcurrant. Full of energy and joie de vivre, Dolce Rose is an irresistibly enchanting composition. Intense fruity top notes open the composition in a triad of fresh green apple, juicy mandarin and tangy redcurrant. In the heart note, white peach appeals to our sense of taste and opens our senses to a floral bouquet of velvety magnolia blossoms and majestic roses. The unique character of the fragrance is created from a composition of two rose notes: The dewy clarity of a centifolia essence combines with the soft sensuality of rose absolute to create an unmistakable rose fragrance. This powerful note is embedded in a mantle of soft musk tones, to which sandalwood and other noble light wood notes lend a beguilingly sensual quality. The bottle shares its soft curves and elegantly feminine silhouette with the original Dolce fragrance, but now dips its glass in a rose-red colour in which the eponymous blossom seems to glow. The unmistakable flower cap is now also dressed in a bold red colour that expresses the personality of the Dolce girl and the fascinating facets of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum, launched in 2015, is a deeper and denser interpretation of the classic fragrance concept. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart unfolds, in which striking notes of ginger and cardamom meet the subtle nuance of orange blossom. These elements finally merge into a persistent base characterised by accords of tobacco, amber and cedar wood, giving the perfume its woody character. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the contents: A heavy, rectangular glass body reveals the brown liquid and is topped with a colour-coordinated, dark brown cap. The clear, geometric lines are only accentuated by a silver inscription on the front, which completes the overall aesthetic look. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The One Eau de Parfum Intense is a fascinating reinterpretation of the well-known classic. Perfumer Quentin Bisch is responsible for this composition, which combines tried-and-tested elements with new accents. Bright notes of spicy pink pepper meet the freshness of mandarin and the fruitiness of blackcurrant in the opening. At the centre of the creation is a striking jasmine note that gives the fragrance a distinct floral character. This heart note transitions gently into a persistent base. Here, creamy vanilla and rich amber accords come together to create a harmonious finish. This combination creates an aura of opulence and warmth that remains perceptible for several hours. The high-quality content is also reflected visually. A heavy, rectangular bottle made of amber-coloured glass with clear, rounded edges houses the golden liquid. A wide, shiny metallic cap in a gold tone rounds off the design harmoniously. Black letters on the front provide a clear contrast to the warm colour of the glass and underline the modern elegance of the presentation. The eau de parfum is available in different quantities, such as 50 ml or 100 ml, to suit different needs. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of passion and elegance with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This intensified version of the popular Devotion fragrance is a tribute to the timeless beauty and power of love. With its unique fragrance composition, this perfume takes you on a sensual journey. Intense perfume for intense moments The fragrance profile opens with an aromatic top note of hazelnut, which immediately captivates your senses. The floral elegance of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the perfume, lending the fragrance a delicate, feminine note. The base note rounds off the composition with warm, sweet vanilla, which ensures a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Intense Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is characterised by its particularly concentrated formulation, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant bottle with its characteristic golden cap is not only a container for the precious fragrance, but also a real piece of jewellery for your dressing table. To optimise the fragrance, it is recommended to apply the perfume to pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolleté. It is particularly suitable for special occasions and evening events, but also gives you an aura of luxury and sophistication in everyday life. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique combination of nutty, floral and sweet notes. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of devotion and elegance that accompanies you throughout the day and emphasises your individual personality.
